note: Wave 4. The 50-row shortlist in content/keywords/2026-09-09-ganesh-chaturthi/build.mjs is EXHAUSTED — 137 of its keyword strings are covered by the 36 existing posts and only 6 rows are uncovered, 5 of them near-duplicates of live posts. Every keyword below therefore comes from the harvested autocomplete pool (pool.csv, 1,777 rows), which is the same evidence standard the original list used (evidence_type AUTOCOMPLETE). Relevance score from pool.csv is quoted per row. 13 assignments to land 10 posts; wave 3 aborted 3 of 14 on the cannibalisation gate and that rate should be expected again.

assignments.separation: The date post answers the tithi and the muhurat. This answers the WORKING question: which states gazette it, whether banks and schools close, and whether it is a national holiday (it is not). Different question, different reader.
assignments.researchLane: State gazette / public-holiday scheduling; regional variation in observance. Not panchang.
assignments.angleSeed: The lead-time dataset is unusually relevant here: 49.4% of Raksha Bandhan pages were built on the festival day itself, which is what a public holiday does to behaviour. Both §1 disclosures apply.
assignments.formatRisk: A state-by-state table is table stakes; get the values right or omit the table.
folds: is ganesh chaturthi a national holiday

assignments.separation: The photos post is an asset-delivery page. This is about generating an image from a text prompt — a 2026 intent that no traditional festival publisher covers, and the one keyword in this batch where first-hand experience is the strongest available evidence.
assignments.researchLane: Text-to-image prompt construction; documented failure modes on religious and cultural iconography. Search the phenomenon: 'text-to-image cultural bias evaluation', not the keyword.
assignments.angleSeed: Publish prompts that were actually run, and say plainly where they broke — a model rendering four arms as four hands is the inconvenient detail that makes the page citable.
assignments.formatRisk: Do not present untested prompts as tested. If you did not run it, do not claim an output.

assignments.keyword: why ganesh chaturthi is not celebrated in north india
assignments.separation: The essay post is a school-essay format on what the festival is. This answers a specific geographic question with a false premise inside it — it IS observed in north India, differently and more privately — and correcting a false premise well is a strong citation position.
assignments.researchLane: Historical geography of the public festival; the 1890s Pune public-pandal turn; regional religious practice studies.
assignments.angleSeed: Lead by correcting the premise, then explain the public-vs-domestic distinction that produces the impression.
assignments.formatRisk: This touches religious practice across regions. Describe, do not rank or judge. No claim that one region observes 'properly'.
folds: why ganesh chaturthi is not celebrated in uttarakhand

assignments.keyword: how ganesh chaturthi is celebrated in maharashtra
assignments.separation: Puja vidhi is the ritual procedure at home, step by step. This is the observed practice across ten days at community scale. HIGH cannibalisation risk against BOTH the vidhi post and lalbaugcha-raja-mumbai — gate against both, and abort if either shares 3+ results.
assignments.researchLane: Ethnography of the Maharashtra public festival; mandal organisation; the ten-day arc.
assignments.angleSeed: The ten-day arc as a schedule a reader can follow day by day, which neither sibling provides.
assignments.formatRisk: Highest abort probability in the batch. Do the gate honestly.

assignments.separation: Udyapan is the CONCLUDING rite — the vrata's formal completion — distinct from installation (puja vidhi) and from immersion (ganpati-visarjan-2026). Verify that distinction from a source before drafting; if the sources treat udyapan and visarjan as one act, say so and abort rather than manufacturing a difference.
assignments.researchLane: Vrata completion rites in Hindu domestic ritual; primary ritual texts in open-access translation.
assignments.angleSeed: The rite most guides skip because it happens after the photogenic part.
assignments.formatRisk: Genuine risk of inventing a distinction. Cite or abort.
folds: ganesh chaturthi udyapan vidhi in hindi

assignments.separation: Different city, different observance — Bengaluru's is Karnataka's Gauri-Ganesha pairing, not Mumbai's mandal culture. The sibling is Mumbai-specific, so the SERPs should separate cleanly.
assignments.researchLane: Karnataka observance; Gauri Habba; urban festival organisation in Bengaluru.
assignments.angleSeed: The Gauri-Ganesha pairing is the fact a Mumbai-shaped article misses entirely.
assignments.formatRisk: Do not list pandals you cannot verify exist in 2026. An unverifiable venue list is worse than no list.

assignments.separation: A school or office NOTICE BOARD — flat, A1-ish, paper and pins, seen by a corridor — against a home mandap, which is three-dimensional and lit. Different constraint, different audience. Also gate against ganesh-chaturthi-decoration-ideas and ganesh-chaturthi-banner-and-poster: three decoration siblings already exist, so this is a real risk.
assignments.researchLane: Classroom display and visual-learning research; paper craft constraints.
assignments.angleSeed: Constraints a home guide never states: no flame, no water, must survive a week of a corridor, must read from three metres.
assignments.formatRisk: Do not restate the home-decoration post with the word 'board' substituted. If that is all you have, abort.

assignments.separation: A WhatsApp group name is a persistent 25-character label for a mandal or family group. A caption is a one-time post. Different artefact, different length constraint.
assignments.researchLane: Naming conventions and character limits in messaging platforms; group identity research.
assignments.angleSeed: Name against the actual WhatsApp constraint and say what it is, which no listicle does.
assignments.formatRisk: This is a list-of-names keyword and will want to become 200 names of padding. Do not pad: the band is the band, and a shorter list with the constraint explained is the differentiator. Include the Kannada fold only if you can set the script correctly.
folds: ganesh chaturthi group name in kannada

assignments.separation: No sibling covers dress at all — the cleanest lane in the batch. But note the inverse risk: first-party data has nothing to say about clothing, so the Phase 0 gate is the binding constraint here, not the SERP gate.
assignments.researchLane: Regional textile and dress practice; festival dress custom in Maharashtra and Karnataka.
assignments.angleSeed: Only proceed if you can honestly find 3 relevant first-party facts with 2 that fit the first 150 words. If the only available facts are generic platform-behaviour numbers, they fail the swap test and you should ABORT and say so.
assignments.formatRisk: Highest Phase 0 abort probability. Do not force platform statistics into a clothing post.

assignments.separation: A mandal logo is a reusable identity mark — it must work at 200px, in one colour, on a receipt and on a 20-foot arch. A banner is one-off artwork at one size. Gate carefully; if the SERPs merge, abort in favour of the live banner post.
assignments.researchLane: Logo legibility at small sizes; single-colour reproduction; visual identity research.
assignments.angleSeed: The reproduction constraint no festival design listicle mentions.
assignments.formatRisk: Do not describe logos you have not seen. Describe constraints and let the reader apply them.

assignments.separation: Sixth language lane. Five exist (Marathi, Gujarati, Kannada, Tamil, Telugu) and they separate cleanly from each other, so this is structurally the safest assignment — but the volume is the lowest in the batch (601 against 1,250+) and in Odisha the observance is Ganesh Puja with a school-and-college emphasis, which is a genuine content difference to lead with.
assignments.researchLane: Odia language and script; Ganesh Puja in Odisha.
assignments.angleSeed: Odisha's student-centred observance, which no pan-India wishes page mentions.
assignments.formatRisk: Odia script must be correct. If you cannot verify the script renders and reads correctly, transliterate and say that you did, or abort — a language post with broken script is worse than none.

assignments.separation: RESERVE — highest volume in the pool but the fourth decoration keyword. Only run this if an earlier assignment aborts, and gate it against all three decoration siblings.
assignments.angleSeed: Only viable if it is specifically about the backdrop panel behind the idol as a distinct object.
assignments.formatRisk: Probably a merge with the home-decoration post. Expect to abort.

assignments.separation: RESERVE — lettering as a craft, against the banner post's finished artwork. Only run if an earlier assignment aborts.
assignments.researchLane: Devanagari letterform construction; brush and pen lettering.
assignments.angleSeed: Letterform construction rather than downloadable art.
assignments.formatRisk: Merges easily with the banner post. Gate hard.
